Description: 
 The Business Intelligence Development Analyst is a member of the Information Delivery Development team within the Information Technology Shared Services organization. The Business Intelligence Development analyst is responsible for transforming business requirements into a functional/technical design, followed by developing business solutions using defined global strategic reporting and presentation tools. The toolset focus for this individual consists of the presentation layer tools within SAP, Spotfire, and Microsoft BI.
  
 Responsibilities: 
  
 The Information Delivery Development Analyst may be responsible for:
 Analyzing business requirements, designing, and developing business solutions using defined global strategic reporting and presentation tools, with a focus on SAP (Xcelsius, Webi & Universe, Crystal Reports), Spotfire, and Microsoft BI.
 Providing governance and quality assurance for user self-service around global strategic reporting tools.
 Providing training and consulting on business intelligence tools and processes.
 Assessing and testing new releases of software for strategic tools.
 Evaluating new tools for inclusion in the Global strategic toolset.
 Responding to internal and external audit requirements.
 Establishing and ensuring corporate guidelines, standards, and best practices in the use and deployment of the leveraged business intelligence solutions.
 Work with vendor support to troubleshoot implemented tools and environments.
  
  
 Basic/Required: 
 Legally authorized to work in the United States
 7+ years of experience in IT
 3+ years of BI development experience
 Ability and willingness to travel if needed
 
 Preferred: 
 Bachelor's Degree in MIS, computer science, information technology, or Mathematics
 Demonstrated analytical and problem solving ability.
 Proven experience translating business requirements into successful functional and technical designs
 Demonstrated ability to network and communicate, to show leadership and influence with diverse cultures and business groups.
 1+ years of direct experience in the oil and gas industry.
 3 + years of direct experience with software/application support and development.
 1+ years of direct experience with BW Structures.
 5+ years of experience with 3 or more of these Business Intelligence tools: SAP BW, Business Objects XI 3.1 or 4.0 combined.
 Demonstrated ability of being customer focused and business driven.
 Demonstrated ability to meet commitments and manage performance.
 Demonstrated ability of being self-driven.
 Demonstrated ability to multi-task in a team environment.
 

 Apply today!
